flavor: The air here is a physical weight, shimmering with a dry, blistering heat that turns the horizon into a dancing blur. Beneath your boots, the floor is a mosaic of jagged, blackened obsidian, glowing with a dull, rhythmic crimson light from the fissures below.
name: The Cinder-Glass Crucible
reason: The narrow, heat-warped corridor forces the party into a bottleneck, ensuring the elite guardian can engage the front line without being flanked, while the intense heat imposes a taxing toll on their stamina.
